auditions.production: 2026 Festival Season (Much Ado About Nothing, Macbeth, Private Lives, The Last Five Years, Fences)

auditionDates.notes: Walk-in, no appointment needed. Sign-ups begin 10:30am. Everyone will be seen.
Equity members by appointment via AEA website. Non-union join waiting list day-of.

rolesAvailable.description: Doubles across The Last Five Years, Private Lives, Much Ado About Nothing, and Macbeth
All characters in Fences yet to be cast are Black. Doubles with Macbeth.
Various roles across all five productions in repertory

prep.acting: Two contrasting pieces under three minutes total, at least one Shakespeare. Shorter is better.

auditions.notes: Video submissions also accepted: upload to YouTube (no Vimeo or Google Drive), under three minutes, two contrasting pieces at least one Shakespeare. Send link to auditions@santacruzshakespeare.org. First rehearsal June 9; all shows rehearse in repertory. LOA contract, $839 weekly minimum (2025 rates).
